what: The MSS one-value REMUS 100 hull, mass, site, hull loads and propeller (base file), with every added-mass Coriolis term kept, the body lift in both planes as one point force, and four effective-angle fins whose lift slope is computed from the fin geometry. Straight-line stable at its cruise speed; a sibling of REMUS 100 (MSS), not a vehicle identification.

base.what: every value not listed below: SpheroidAuv (length, diameter = beam, body_mass from one_value.mass, body_center_of_gravity, roll_added_inertia_ratio), Site (latitude from gravity.latitude_rad, water_density), SubmergedRestoring (center_of_buoyancy, neutral), AuvHullLoads (time_constants, damping_ratios, planform_area, parasitic_drag_coefficient, oswald_efficiency, span, hull_frontal_drag_coefficient), Propeller (all its entries); kinematic viscosity 1e-6 m^2/s (cylinderDrag.m 81)

coriolis_form.source: every added-mass Coriolis term kept (m2c.m 33-48; Fossen 2011, eq. 6.43, p. 120); kept only with the point-force body lift and effective-angle fins with the geometric lift slope, and only with the straight-line stability gate green

current_form.source: still water (the gates run without current)

body_lift_slope_method.source: Prestero 2001, eqs. 4.30-4.32, p. 30 (Hoerner 1965, p. 13-3, not read); l/d = 1.6 / 0.19 = 8.42, inside the stated 6.7-10

body_lift_slope_per_degree.source: Prestero 2001, eq. 4.31, p. 30 (c_y_beta = 0.003, after Hoerner 1965, not read)

pressure_centre_method.source: Prestero 2001, eq. 4.35, p. 31; nose at +L/2 (hull centred on the body origin, remus100.m 131, 134)

pressure_centre_fraction.source: Prestero 2001, eq. 4.35, p. 31 (0.65 l); Hoerner's range 0.6-0.7 l as Prestero p. 31 gives it -- the gates also run 0.60 and 0.70; owner's choice of the one value, 2026-10-13

hull_drag_form.source: the drag half of forceLiftDrag.m 28-40 kept, so that only the lift changes against REMUS 100 (MSS); its induced part still uses the wing's vertical-plane lift coefficient (an MSS residual, stated)

roll_damping_form.source: Dmtrx.m 39-55 (no identified quadratic roll coefficient for this vehicle)

fin.what: four Fin parts: two rudder fins on the rudder command, two stern-plane fins on the stern-plane command (the vehicle's inputs are the four fin commands in this order, then the shaft speed; a pair receives one command twice)

fin_area.source: Prestero 2001, Table 2.2, p. 17 (S_fin, one fin); the same area remus100.m 179 uses

section_lift_efficiency.source: Prestero 2001, Table 2.2, p. 17 and eq. 4.38, p. 31 (the empirical factor a-bar, after Hoerner 1965 p. 3-2, not read)

lift_slope_computed.value_note: 3.1158 1/rad per fin = [1/(2 pi 0.9) + 1/(pi 2 0.0857^2/0.00665)]^-1; Prestero 2001, Table 2.2, p. 17 prints 3.12 (derived, not declared)

servo_dynamics.source: remus100.m 113-114: the command is the deflection, saturated

convention.source: MSS's command convention of remus100.m 242, 245, 254: a positive rudder command moves the trailing edge to starboard (lift -y, starboard turn), a positive stern-plane command moves it down (lift -z, nose down)

shaft_speed.what: 920.088 rpm, the speed holding 1.54 m/s straight in the one-value MSS model (fzero; Prestero 2001, Table 8.1, p. 60: u = 1.54 m/s); the part's straight-running equilibrium at this shaft speed is its cruise state
